subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw accept Telegram album/sendMediaGroup support in the bundled Telegram message tool, and should maintainers land/port the linked draft PR or require a different API shape?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the public action shape and integration boundary are product/API choices because current main already supports sequential mediaUrls and the linked draft adds a separate Telegram-specific action.

options.title: Port a focused album implementation
options.body: Adopt the useful linked work into current main with an API that fits existing mediaUrls/message.send semantics and preserves all current fallbacks.

options.title: Keep sequential media fanout only
options.body: Document that OpenClaw intentionally sends multiple media items separately and close the album request after maintainer rationale is posted.

options.title: Request a new API proposal first
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a narrower design covering caption/buttons/threading/fallback semantics before implementation proceeds.

recommendation.title: Port a focused album implementation
recommendation.body: Adopt the useful linked work into current main with an API that fits existing mediaUrls/message.send semantics and preserves all current fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: He already handled the prior cleanup review and has the strongest recent Telegram seam history in the inspected files.
